values.value: Sub-cent precision drift on QuoteLine NetPrice

Finds: SBQQ__QuoteLine__c records where SBQQ__NetPrice__c carries more than 2 decimal places of precision. Why it matters: Downstream systems (NetSuite, billing engines, invoice PDFs) typically support only 2-decimal currency. Quote lines with 4-6 decimal precision produce cent-level mismatches that surface on PO-cut customer invoices and during Q-to-O reconciliation. Almost always historical records from before a precision fix — current quotes are clean, but unfixed back-catalog continues to drive recurring billing-recon work every renewal cycle. Suppress a finding: when the precision is intentional (e.g. usage-based / metered products where sub-cent unit prices roll up cleanly to whole-cent line totals). Disable the detector: only if your billing system natively handles >2-decimal precision and there's no downstream constraint.
